Good evening support team,
After closing changed little, but comfort stops stayed in focus

The handoff notes showed a steady flow of pet cases, and the ground team kept carriers moving with care between services. I checked the latest notes from the safety coordinator and flagged anything that could affect handling, spacing, or calm boarding. <<FACT F113>> The review also asked us to keep communication brisk and respectful, especially when a traveler is already uneasy about transit or a pet has a sensitive temperament.

Please keep the record trail clean for the next shift and note any unusual behavior, crate issues, or delayed support steps as soon as they appear. <<FACT F118>> That detail matters when a case comes back through the desk, since the file needs to show what was seen, what was done, and what follow-up was offered. If you speak with a traveler, keep the tone steady, give clear next steps, and avoid loose wording. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will rely on those notes to keep service consistent.
